description: 한국 여행 안내·관광 통계 (Korea Basics): Search by a few words or a short question. Finds rules and guide pages, travel tool cards, countries, places and collections, and returns the top matches with an id for the other tools and the page URL. Rules, guides and countries match in any language the site uses (English, Korean, Japanese, Chinese, Thai, Russian); places match by their English or Korean name. Use it when it is unclear which tool fits. For festivals and dates use get_korea_dates.

query.description: A few words or a short question, e.g. "K-ETA", "duty free alcohol", "免税", "Gyeongbokgung", "plug adapter".
